5. **`readHeadRef` regex** — `(.+)$` in multiline mode can capture trailing spaces on a non-final line.

6. **`gitDiffProvider` loses `readonly`** — lazy init via `getGitDiffProvider()` weakens immutability.

7. **Concrete class in option type** — changing from `Pick<GitDiffProvider, ...>` to `GitDiffProvider` forces tests to extend the real class.

8. **`void callback` pattern** — unconventional way to suppress unused-parameter warnings.
